comparison.objective: Candidate sets an industrial gripper opening stop; PR-1906 performs an insulin-pen safety shot and dials a dose.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires simultaneous wrench and driver torque control; PR-1906 requires shield removal, orientation, axial injection, and dose-knob/window manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° opening retained over cycles; PR-1906 requires a valid 2-unit priming shot followed by a final 12-unit setting.
comparison.reason: Rotary adjustment is only a generic primitive; medication priming and dosing test a different mechanism and outcome.
